name: 39150 · Port Gibson, MS
findings: ZIP 39150 (Port Gibson) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39150 (Port Gibson) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
75% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
